name: v3_elado_poisson
_comment: ELADO (Ehebrecht et al. 2026, arXiv 2606.20771; Zenodo 20738464) Poisson set, HDF5 decompressed byte for byte from the .zst. x = coefficient a (N, H, W), y = solution u (N, H, W); -div(a grad u) = 1 on the unit square, u = 0 on the boundary, P1 finite elements (dolfinx), coefficient and solution on the (N_cells+1)^2 vertex grid (scripts.tar.zst: poisson_dirichlet.py).
